title: Being A Girl
author: Malini Mohanty
text:
Is My Proud Possession
Growing Up With Much Pampers
I Feel to Be in Empyrean

No Worries No Care
No Burden Ever Dare
To Bring Me Havoc or
To Keep Me in Disgust

Love is in the Air
For Me it`s Boundless
Much from My Kith & Kin
More from People Associated

Undaunted I Do
Everything that I Decide
No Limit Has Ever
Put My Desires Behind

Never ever Believed in Luck
Never ever Tried to Compromise
Always Moved with Steadfastness
With Whatever I Determined

Much More I Received
Than What I Anticipated
Blessings & Love Countless
Has Fulfilled My Life Undoubted

Thank You Almighty
For Making Me A Girl
I`d Love to Have Same Life
Even in My Next Birth
stanzas: I Feel to Be in Empyrean
I`d Love to Have Same Life
